headline: RACE DAY DONE — sub-2h00 missed, but a well-executed, honest effort
summary:
Finished in ~2h14 (8050s moving, 22.1km/825m D+) at an average HR of 172bpm — well above the prescribed 163-172bpm climb band and the 168-178bpm "open up" finish, meaning this was raced near threshold essentially throughout rather than paced per the plan's progression. The LTHR achievement (176bpm for 1h) and RPE 9 confirm this was a genuine hard effort, not a comfortable sub-2 cruise; feel was 3 (Normal), consistent with a tough but controlled day out. No pain or ITB signal reported, cadence held around 78-79spm. Sub-2h00 needed ~5:30/km average and the data suggest the climbs or terrain cost more than the 914m D+ pacing model assumed — the HR profile shows this was a solid, fully-committed trail half, just not quite the target split.</summary>
<parameter name="flags">["No knee/calf pain flagged — stop rule wasn't triggered, so no forced walk segments today.", "Average HR 172 vs a prescribed 163-172 climb ceiling suggests the whole race ran hot relative to plan, likely explaining the time miss more than fitness did."]
suggestedChange: Log a short debrief note on where time was lost (climbs vs descents vs flats) next time GPS/splits are available, to calibrate the next race's pacing targets — propose reviewing lap data with Alberto before the next key race.
